name: EPIC 201541578
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 20.1 solar radii and 1.70 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201541578 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 20.088517 (16th-84th percentiles 19.919159-20.31038), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 18,071 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.70 solar masses and 20.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,195 K at its surface.
